config_dir.description: The directory where Transmission looks for configuration files. Corresponds to the -g flag or TRANSMISSION_HOME environment variable.

paused.description: If true, all newly added torrents start in a paused state. Corresponds to the -p flag.

minimized.description: If true, the window starts minimized in the notification area. Corresponds to the -m flag.

download_dir.description: Path to the directory where completed downloads are saved.

incomplete_dir.description: Path to the directory where incomplete downloads are saved. If empty, uses download-dir.

incomplete_dir_enabled.description: If true, incomplete downloads are saved to incomplete-dir instead of download-dir.

peers_max_per_torrent.description: Maximum number of peers to connect to per torrent.

peers_max_global.description: Maximum number of peers to connect to globally.

speed_limit_up_enabled.description: If true, enforce the global upload speed limit.

speed_limit_up_kib.description: Maximum upload speed limit in KiB/s when speed-limit-up-enabled is true.

speed_limit_down_enabled.description: If true, enforce the global download speed limit.

speed_limit_down_kib.description: Maximum download speed limit in KiB/s when speed-limit-down-enabled is true.

ratio_limit.description: Seed torrents until they reach this ratio of uploaded to downloaded data.

ratio_limit_enabled.description: If true, enforce the seed ratio limit.
